steps.title: Load payer policies, chunk by section, embed
steps.what: Split 3 payer policy manuals into 21 sections and embedded each one (TF-IDF stand-in for an embedding model + pgvector).

steps.title: Retrieve this payer's criteria for the procedure
steps.what: For each request, searched only that payer's sections; the top hit was the right procedure section for 6/6 requests.
steps.code:
hits = idx.search(f"{procedure} CPT {cpt} medically necessary criteria",
                  k=3, payer=req["payer"])  # metadata filter = WHERE payer = $1
criteria = criteria_from_section(hits[0].text)

steps.title: Map chart evidence to each criterion, with citations
steps.what: Claude read each request's chart notes as cited documents and marked every criterion MET / NOT MET / MISSING; 0 MET claims lacked a citation.
steps.code:
content = [{"type": "document", "title": note["title"],
            "source": {"type": "text", "media_type": "text/plain", "data": note["text"]},
            "citations": {"enabled": True}} for note in req["notes"]]
blocks = ask_cited(system=MAP_SYSTEM, documents=req["notes"], prompt=criteria_list)
findings = parse_findings(blocks)  # block.citations -> cited_text, document_title

steps.title: Flag missing evidence and draft the necessity letter
steps.what: Packets for 2 requests are ready; 4 are flagged with the exact items staff must obtain first.
steps.code:
class PacketDraft(BaseModel):
    ready_to_submit: bool
    missing_items: list[str]
    letter: str

draft = ask_structured(system=LETTER_SYSTEM, content=findings_json, schema=PacketDraft)

steps.title: Staff review and submit; every edit becomes eval data
steps.what: Staff corrected 4 of 28 fields (14% edit rate); each edit was saved to eval_set.jsonl. Complete packets went out; the rest were held for documents.
steps.code:
if model_status != staff_status:

steps.title: Score against the nurse's answer key
steps.what: Compared every criterion decision with a prior-auth nurse's hand labels.
steps.code:
pairs = [(findings[rid][cid].status, nurse) for rid, cid, nurse in answer_key]
agree = mean(model == nurse for model, nurse in pairs)
gaps = [c for c in answer_key if c.nurse != 'MET']
gap_recall = mean(findings[c].status != 'MET' for c in gaps)

story.situation: A specialty clinic's prior-auth team spends hours per request matching each payer's rules to chart notes, and incomplete packets come back denied weeks later.
story.constraints: Chart notes are PHI, so the whole system runs under a BAA with no data retention outside the tenant. Every claim in a packet must point to a chart sentence. Staff, not the model, submit.
story.replay: Reuse: retrieve-the-rules, map-evidence-with-citations, human-submits works for any rules-vs-records check (claims, underwriting, audits). Next time: capture staff edits from day one so the eval set grows with real cases.
story.problem_cost: About 2.4 staff hours per request, and roughly 3 in 10 first submissions denied for missing documentation.

metrics.first_pass_approvals: 50% if sent as-is -> 3/3 submitted packets complete
metrics.denials_avoided: 3 incomplete packets held before submission (REQ-102, REQ-103, REQ-105)
